prerequisites: Knowledge of issues related to the field of study: technical and non-technical.

learning_outcomes.text: The student understands the need for lifelong learning and updating of knowledge. The student complies with the principles of professional ethics and demonstrates entrepreneurship and professionalism in the performance of duties.
The student is able to use knowledge to plan and measure the operating parameters of mechanical devices. The student is able to use specialized measuring equipment and analyzes the obtained results.

The student has knowledge and is able to design technological processes for the production of typical machine parts and mechanical devices. The student is able to use analytical and numerical computational tools to perform implementation of project tasks.

The student is able to identify and formulate a constructional or technological task in Polish and in a foreign language and has the ability to present results using computer programs and other supporting tools.

assessment_methods.method: Report on the realization of the internship

assessment_rules: The passing threshold for each component (professional training information card, report, and internship sheet) is 100%.
